reviewer: Codex child /root/mesh_audit; did not author the five candidate implementation/test files
scope: Read-only source audit, synthetic regression tests, and isolated copied-database replay of the actual frozen n1 result. No paid CLI, no Blender invocation, no native binary rebuild and no visual/business acceptance claim.
source_encoding: All five candidate files UTF-8 without BOM, LF; exact announced candidate hashes retained after checks.

resolved_findings.finding: Actual n1 provider succeeded but metadata-only reference_images content_sha256 was treated as an inline content declaration, raising KeyError(content_base64) and leaving the executor node running.
resolved_findings.fix: Reference evidence metadata uses reference_sha256, preserving exact source/reference ordering and digests. True inline mesh/image payloads retain content_sha256 plus content_base64.

resolved_findings.finding: A permanently invalid result from an already succeeded provider could be polled indefinitely.
resolved_findings.fix: After result retrieval succeeds, output/content validation failures become terminal node failed/invalid_result while retaining the actual provider succeeded receipt. Manifest merge/global immutable asset failures also fail terminal and rollback the result savepoint.

verified_behavior: check_content still requires both inline content fields to be strings, validates base64, and validates the digest. Metadata digest keys do not weaken true snapshot validation.
The result-validation phase starts only after result_manifest returns. Transient provider.poll and result retrieval errors remain recoverable provider_operation_failed and do not resubmit.

Terminal invalid results are excluded from cache and node preview/export; reopening and repeated step do not poll or resubmit them. Existing retry requires an actual provider failed receipt, preventing invalid-result replay.
Global asset immutability conflict after a preceding new output insertion rolls back all result asset insertion and leaves the cache empty.
GDScript acceptance source now compares ordered reference_sha256 metadata against the two actual reference file digests; native execution of this script remains the parent integrator responsibility.

actual_frozen_n1.historical_artifact_policy: The original n1 SQLite databases, bundle, result, receipt and validated plan were never edited. The two metadata key renames were applied only to an in-memory compatibility copy; this is not migration or recovery of the original real run.

narrow_source_suite.model_runtime: Synthetic C# CLI fixture only; no GPT/Codex or Blender call
